Sparkling Demerara Sugar CookiesThese crisp, buttery cookies are rolled in coarse Real Hanif's Demerara Sugar before baking, creating a beautiful sparkling crust and a satisfyingly crunchy texture.Ingredients
1/2 cup Real Hanif's Demerara Sugar (for rolling)
Prep: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Cream: In a large bowl, beat the softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract until just combined.
Combine Dry: In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, and salt. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing on low speed until a soft dough forms.
Roll: Scoop dough into 1-inch balls. Roll each ball generously in the bowl of Real Hanif's Demerara Sugar to coat completely.
Bake: Place the sugared dough balls two inches apart on the prepared baking sheets. Bake for 8–10 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden.
Cool: Let cool on the baking sheet for 2 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

/product/tamarind-concentrate.title: TAMARIND CONCENTRATE
/product/tamarind-concentrate.description: Delicious in curries, sauces, drinks and desserts
h2: Loved for Generations. Made for Today.
p: There are hundreds of ways to use tamarind concentrate and they work in almost every cuisine.

Tamarind concentrate is a thick, dark paste derived from the pulp of the tamarind fruit, offering a unique, tangy-sour flavor with a hint of sweetness. It's used to add depth and complexity to both sweet and savory dishes, and is known for its convenience as it's ready to use.
Tamarind has been growing in popularity over recent years as chefs and home cooks get more creative in the kitchen and realize the benefits of this versatile ingredient.
Special tip: Dilute Hanif's Tamarind Concentrate with water to suit your palate. Use concentrate to make a cooling Tamarind drink during the warmer months.
Tangy Tamarind Glazed Chicken WingsThese wings offer a perfect balance of sweet, sour, and spicy, creating a sticky, caramelized glaze that is irresistible.Ingredients
1/2 tsp chili flakes (or more for heat)
Prepare the Wings: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Pat the wings dry and season lightly with salt and pepper. Arrange them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper for easy cleanup.
Bake: Bake for 30 minutes, or until the wings are mostly cooked and the skin is starting to crisp.

Make the Glaze: While the wings bake, whisk together the oil, tamarind concentrate, brown sugar, soy sauce, rice vinegar, minced garlic, grated ginger, and chili flakes in a small saucepan. Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat and cook for 3-5 minutes, stirring until the sugar is dissolved and the glaze has thickened slightly.

Glaze and Finish: Remove the wings from the oven. Brush them liberally with the tamarind glaze. Return them to the oven for another 5-10 minutes, or until the glaze is sticky and caramelized. Serve immediately, garnished with sesame seeds or chopped cilantro if desired.

h2: Beef Taco Bowl with Crispy Onions
Loved for Generations. Made for Today.
p: Hanif's legendary Crispy Onions are thinly sliced onions, fried to a golden brown and crispy perfection. They are known for their versatility, adding a flavorful and crunchy texture to almost any savoury dish.

Beef Taco Bowl with Real Hanif's Crispy OnionsThis recipe delivers a satisfying, scratch-made taco bowl, topped with the perfect crunch of Real Hanif's Crispy Onions.Ingredients
For the Beef: 1 lb ground beef, 2 tbsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 cup water.

For the Bowl: 2 cups cooked brown rice, 1 cup chopped romaine lettuce, 1/2 cup diced fresh tomato, 1/2 cup shredded cheddar/Monterey Jack cheese, 1/4 cup salsa (homemade or store-bought), 1/4 cup sour cream or plain Greek yogurt.
Topping: 1/2 cup Real Hanif's Crispy Onions.

Taco Beef: Brown the ground beef in a skillet. Drain excess fat. Stir in all the spices (chili powder through salt) and the water. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid reduces and the beef is richly seasoned.
Assemble: In a large bowl, spread the cooked rice as a base. Layer the seasoned taco beef, lettuce, diced tomato, and shredded cheese over the rice.

Finish: Top the bowl with a dollop of salsa and sour cream/yogurt. Finish by scattering a generous amount of Real Hanif's Crispy Onions over the entire bowl for a delicious, savory crunch. Serve immediately.
